description: Lists Google Documents from your Google Drive with optional filtering.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of documents to return (1-100).

orderBy.description: Sort order for results. Keys without 'desc' sort ascending, so 'modifiedTime' is oldest-first.

query.description: Search query to filter documents by name or content.

name: listGoogleDocs
